children: Polymarket odds for the "LoL: Invictus Gaming vs. Team WE - LPL playoffs" event saw sharp volatility in the "match winner" submarket, with Invictus Gaming's implied probability falling from 78.5% one hour earlier to 57.5%.
According to ChainCatcher, the move marked a 21% swing in the market, and the article said related breaking news may have affected the change.

title: Polymarket Invictus Gaming Match-Winner Odds Drop 21%
